findings.evidence: game/modules/tome/data/talents/corruptions/plague.lua:159-171 iterates all collected diseases with ipairs; info any diseases describes all existing diseases, not a choice.
findings.resolution: 将任意疾病传播 → 将目标身上的所有疾病传播; preserve resistance semantics and remaining wording.

findings.evidence: game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/agility.lua Vault uses shield attackTargetWith before move; info Leap onto ... with your shield. 用盾牌踩 misstates action.
findings.resolution: 首句用盾牌踩在临近目标上 → 持盾跃向相邻目标; retain shield damage, 2-turn Daze=眩晕, springboard and destination semantics.
